notes: Runs used the corpus-three-cities worktree. TODO.md figures (90 of 200, 9 of 11) come from the earlier hand-built fixture and differ slightly from these script runs. status values: open, fixed. probe: True = still present, null = READ only.

findings.title: Nobody can pay, so no scene happens
findings.evidence: provisions defaults to 2, the cost is 3, and nothing creates provisions. Corpus: 0 of 40 passes reached a scene. Fixture: cannot_afford for default characters (2 of 6 at the gate), paid only where the fixture set 8.

findings.title: A locally available need costs energy and goes nowhere
findings.evidence: Step 4 returns after the routine roll: no history entry, no scene. 19 of 40 corpus passes, 54 of 200 fixture passes. In a three-city world every need is available at home. See OPEN_QUESTIONS.

findings.title: The dead can be met and make places "provide"
findings.evidence: No deceased filter in candidates_at, location_provides, find_supplier_locations or travel_graph. 13 of 35 candidates at one corpus city were dead.

findings.title: The criterion shock gate is not in the brief
findings.evidence: SKILL.md says the brief flags a live anchor. pass_prep never runs check_anchor_reference; pass_record runs it after the scene, and the driver throws that and check_resonance away. Moves are model-volunteered; synthesis never fires.

findings.title: The drift instrument has no producer
findings.evidence: REPLY_SCHEMA has no derived_from; lineage_coin has no call site on the unattended path. measure_drift ran and reported no retelling edges (RAN, but the claims were stubs, so the schema is the proof).

findings.title: Meet pool is not filtered by the need
findings.evidence: Everyone with a routine there is a candidate; p2 then has to roll that place and a providing context. 3 of 9 meetings in the fixture.

findings.title: A journey resets on a survive roll
findings.evidence: Step 3 rolls a routine location, so a traveler is back home next time they choose survive. roll_survival is also given the current location as "home".

findings.title: Solo death is recorded, not finished
findings.evidence: See "Known gaps". pass_apply and pass_record still require --p2.

findings.title: conformance_report: wrong invariant, thin coverage
findings.evidence: "parents not also partners" fails 69 times on the pristine corpus, because partner counts now bump on any crossing and the kin exclusion lives in reproduction. Fixed-odds table lists a dead roll and misses survive, meetable, payment.

findings.title: p2, newborns and the dead
findings.evidence: p2 gets no upkeep, eating or energy cost. A newborn has no energy or provisions field (defaults apply). A dead character's provisions vanish.

findings.title: Dead and write-only fields
findings.evidence: leads, social_circle (no writer), last_scene, tempered and cost_ledger (prose only), arc.context; unused tuning keys home_visit_survival_shift and lead_expiry_passes.

findings.title: Stale documentation
findings.evidence: diagrams/gen_simulate_pass.py and simulate-pass.html still draw the pair model with lead override. roll_contested.py and simulate_pass_reproduction.py say partner_threshold 5 (tuning: 3). enact_preamble.md still talks about who is home and who is visiting.

findings.title: Location identity
findings.evidence: travel_graph assumes character.location is an encodings location id. The corpus uses display names, ids are lowercase and routes is empty: location_context --live finds nothing, and I had to rewrite the ids to test travel.

findings.title: Passes that are not scenes leave no trace
findings.evidence: Travel, misses, refusals and arrivals write only location, places_visited and last_scene. Most passes in every run here ended this way. README says each of these things leaves a trace in the corpus. Design question in OPEN_QUESTIONS.

findings.title: The enacter never sees what characters know
findings.evidence: load_character_brief passes criterion, routine and arc premise only. Keeps outside knowledge out, and also keeps the hearsay pool out.

findings.title: provisions_lib.set_provisions has no floor (latent, not reachable)
findings.evidence: Writing -5 stores -5; apply_survival only eats when pool >= 2, apply_upkeep clamps at 0.
